translation:
Surat

Jivanji Maharaj's eldest son is known by the name Vasantdas, Vaishnavdas, or Naranadas. His wife's name was Mathurabai. This Naranadasji ran the gadi (spiritual seat) of Surat. After him, an acharya (spiritual head) is appointed from among the devotees of Surat. When I inquired, I learned a little: that there used to be a tulsi-kyaro (a sacred tulsi-plant platform) behind the temple at Surat, though today no one has information about it. But the line of acharyas of the Surat gadi has continued on from Naranadas. Thus Surat is a punya sthali (a place of religious merit), and today there is a grand temple there.
